excerpt_i18n.en: "Is the cloud giant about to get back into heavy lifting?" Recently, Amazon Web Services (AWS) invested $1 billion to build an "AI on-site engineer" team, a heavy-asset move that seems to "turn back the clock," sparking considerable controversy in the tech circle. For a long time, international cloud giants have loved to tell the story of "extreme standardization": opening public cloud API interfaces and then earning money passively. As for heavy on-site services? Basically, they didn't exist. But in 2026, this model of selling standardized products passively may be about to change. AWS is spending $1 billion to form a team of thousands of "embedded AI engineers," also known as FDEs (Field Deployment Engineers), who will go directly into client offices to help enterprises implement Agents hands-on and build AI production systems. This is not an isolated case. Google, OpenAI, Anthropic, Meta, and other AI and cloud giants have all significantly established FDE positions or specialized companies in the past six months, with total investments exceeding tens of billions of RMB. Domestically, major model and cloud giants like Alibaba, ByteDance, and Tencent have also densely formed "on-site iron armies" in the first half of this year. "Deep on-site," "high-level outsourcing," "IT construction team"... these somewhat negative and outdated labels are now reappearing in the narratives of AI and cloud giants. Why have the cloud giants, which once pursued passive income, suddenly become enthusiastic about on-site services for clients in the AGI era? Will they repeat the mistakes of domestic cloud giants?

excerpt_i18n.en: Changing the story, changing the backing—two recent executive moves are revealing OpenAI's new calculations. According to reports on social platform X, OpenAI security veteran and chief futurist Joshua Achiam recently announced his departure. Almost simultaneously, Washington insider Dean Ball, who has deep White House political and business connections and helped draft U.S. national AI policy, joined OpenAI as "Head of Strategic Foresight." This "one out, one in" is far from a simple job swap. Many industry observers believe this move signals that the idealistic technical safety faction, whose mission is "to ensure AGI benefits all of humanity," is being marginalized within OpenAI, while political and business operators adept at policy-making and maneuvering are entering the core of OpenAI's power. OpenAI's strategic narrative and arbitrage anchor are shifting. 01 The departing technical idealist: Who is Joshua Achiam? Joshua Achiam is widely described in the industry as a typical academic idealist. He earned a dual bachelor's degree in Physics and Aerospace Engineering from the University of Florida, then pursued graduate studies at the world-renowned computer science hub, the University of California, Berkeley, where he obtained a Ph.D. in Electrical Engineering and Computer Science. In 2017, at age 25, Achiam entered OpenAI as an intern. At that time, OpenAI was still a pure, non-profit organization.

items.title: 苹果 Vision Pro 副总裁 Paul Meade 跳槽 OpenAI
items.raw_excerpt: 据彭博社报道，苹果公司负责 Vision Pro 团队的副总裁保罗·米德（Paul Meade）即将离职，加入 OpenAI 的硬件团队。此举与苹果新 CEO 上任后进行人事调整、导致保罗·米德“变相降级”有关。 随着约翰·特努斯（John Ternus）接替库克出任苹果下一任 CEO，原芯片业务掌门人约翰尼·斯鲁吉（Johny Srouji）被提拔为首席硬件官。 斯鲁吉上任后对硬件工程部门进行了颇具争议的激进重组：保罗·米德以及其他几位硬件副总裁，被要求向新任硬件工程副总裁汤姆·马里布（Tom Marieb）汇报，而马里布再向斯鲁吉汇报。 这种管理层级的增加，让保罗·米德等高管感觉自己被“变相降级”，从而引发了离职。 据了解，保罗·米德在苹果工作了超过 15 年，早期负责过 iPad 和 iPhone 的项目管理。自 2017 年起他就加入了 Vision Products Group，并在过去 7 年中深度主导了 Vision Pro 的硬件工程开发。 在离职前，他正带领团队秘密研发苹果对标 Meta Ray-Ban 的第一款无显示屏智能眼镜，该产品原计划于 2027 年底发布。 米德离职后，其原职位将由其长期副手、现任 Vision Pro 和智能眼镜产品设计负责人弗莱彻·罗斯科普夫（Fletcher Rothkopf）接任。 OpenAI 为何招募米德？业内普遍认为，这背后是 OpenAI 硬件战略正从“设计概念”走向“工业制造”。 一年前，OpenAI 已经以 65 亿美元的巨额交易收购了由苹果前首席设计官乔尼·艾夫（Jony Ive）等人创立的 AI 硬件初创公司 io。 相比于乔尼·艾夫团队更偏向外观设计与产品哲学的风格，保罗·米德的加入为 OpenAI 带来了最缺乏的硬核工程能力——如何把极其复杂的传感器、低延迟架构、空间计算组件塞进一个紧凑的消费级设备里。

excerpt_i18n.en: According to Bloomberg, Apple Vice President Paul Meade, who led the Vision Pro team, is set to leave the company and join OpenAI's hardware team. This move is linked to personnel adjustments following Apple's new CEO taking office, which resulted in an effective demotion for Meade. As John Ternus succeeds Tim Cook as Apple's next CEO, former chip chief Johny Srouji has been promoted to Chief Hardware Officer. After taking the role, Srouji implemented a controversial aggressive restructuring of the hardware engineering department: Meade and several other hardware vice presidents were required to report to newly appointed Hardware Engineering Vice President Tom Marieb, who in turn reports to Srouji. This added layer of management led executives like Meade to feel they had been effectively demoted, prompting their departure. Meade had worked at Apple for over 15 years, initially overseeing iPad and iPhone project management. Since 2017, he joined the Vision Products Group and, over the past seven years, deeply led the hardware engineering development of the Vision Pro. Before leaving, he was leading a secret team developing Apple's first display-free smart glasses to compete with Meta Ray-Ban, originally planned for release by the end of 2027.
excerpt_i18n.es: Según Bloomberg, el vicepresidente de Apple a cargo del equipo Vision Pro, Paul Meade, dejará la empresa para unirse al equipo de hardware de OpenAI. Esta decisión está relacionada con los ajustes de personal tras la llegada del nuevo CEO de Apple, que supusieron una «degradación encubierta» para Paul Meade. Con John Ternus sucediendo a Tim Cook como próximo CEO de Apple, el antiguo responsable de chips, Johny Srouji, fue ascendido a jefe de hardware. items.raw_excerpt: 7 月 7 日，支付宝上线AI 开放平台并面向商家、服务商等合作伙伴启动邀测。记者获悉，新瑞鹏集团正受邀参与支付宝AI生态内测，升级养宠服务的智能化体验。 随着双方适配测试推进，未来用户将可用语音快捷唤起养宠服务。在对AI版支付宝“阿宝”说出需求之后，即通过 “安心生活” 服务卡片直达新瑞鹏集团旗下品牌门店的专属服务页面，省去多层页面跳转操作。未来依托平台多端分发能力，新瑞鹏集团宠物服务还可将服务授权通过“阿宝”，在车机、智能穿戴等终端同步上线，用户在多端智能入口都能线上预约宠物诊疗相关服务。 作为国内宠物行业龙头，新瑞鹏旗下拥有瑞鹏、美联众合、宠颐生、安安宠医、芭比堂等众多知名宠物医疗服务品牌，全国连锁宠物医院超千家，业务涵盖宠物诊疗、疫苗驱虫、健康体检、宠物用品等全生命周期服务。 新瑞鹏相关项目负责人韩雪表示，本次参与支付宝AI平台测试，是集团数智化升级的重要一步。未来将持续深挖 AI 交互场景，以智能交互升级养宠服务体验，探索宠物行业全新经营范式。

excerpt_i18n.en: On July 7, Alipay launched its AI open platform and began inviting merchants and service providers for beta testing. Reportedly, New Ruipeng Group is participating in the internal testing of Alipay's AI ecosystem to upgrade the intelligent experience of pet care services. As the compatibility tests progress, users will soon be able to quickly invoke pet care services via voice commands.
